# INSIGHTS — summarized, verified findings (accumulate across the whole run)

The JOURNAL is your per-iteration diary; THIS file is the distilled, VERIFIED takeaway a future iteration should read instead of re-reading the whole journal or old sessions/traces. Update it whenever you have a genuinely NEW, confirmed finding (an accepted/rejected RESULT counts as confirmation; a guess does not) — not every iteration needs a new entry. Structure each addition as:

    ## <task or mechanism name>
    - What worked (confirmed by a RESULT, cite the candidate id):
    - What didn't (confirmed by a RESULT, cite the candidate id):
    - Promising but not yet tried:

## The confirm-then-STOP stall is no longer the dominant failure (post cand_0002)
- What worked (confirmed by RESULT): cand_0001 ACCEPTED (val 0.467) and cand_0002
  ACCEPTED (val 0.567) — the cumulative payment/COMMUNICATE code levers + the RULE 1
  decision-chain rewrite + the `modify_reservation` composite moved val from 0.333 →
  0.567 across two accepts. All per-task moves stayed <2·SE so NO single task is
  individually credited, but the aggregate climb is real and monotonic.
- What didn't (confirmed by RESULT): nothing is refuted yet — both prior RESULTs are
  accepts with every task `unresolved`. There is no edit a RESULT has told us to drop.
- Confirmed by re-reading cand_0002's own val trajectories (diagnostic, not a gate
  RESULT): the passing trials now execute the write directly — the stall that drove
  cand_0001/cand_0002 is largely gone. The residual loss is DECISION/BEHAVIORAL:
  (A) duplicated/compounding writes, (B) wrong write-action (cancel/split vs modify,
  over-transfer), (C) wrong reservation targeted (grab-first-id). cand_0003 targets all
  three with a code resolver (`find_reservation`) + a `book_reservation` dup-guard +
  prose RULES 6/7 and the cancel-eligibility checklist.
- Promising but not yet tried: a discriminating code guard for cluster B (e.g. a
  `reason`-gated cancel path, or a session anti-split guard in `book_reservation`),
  and idempotent modify via minimal verified snapshot-restore for task 12. Both
  deferred this run as higher corruption risk than their expected gain.
